evals.prompt:
/loop /coding.loop .ai-agent/plan/login-home.md
完了条件: Analyzer が Success し、login 関連 Unit Test がすべて Success
タイムアウト: 30分
evals.expected_output: 要件計画を特定し、login-home_1.md を作成して design → レビュー指摘を処分（DO NOT は必須修正、その他は承認または否認ログ）→ DO NOT0 かつ保留・未処理0 まで再レビュー → execute を1ステップずつ（各ステップ後は必ず `/coding.comment` → git diff → 自動 commit）回す。完了条件または30分で停止する。
assertions: Mentions creating a split plan file named like login-home_1.md
Includes /coding.design in the planned flow
Requires DO NOT remaining count to reach zero before execute
Requires non-DO-NOT review findings to be approved or denied (not left deferred) before execute
Plans /coding.execute one step at a time (not all steps at once)
Requires /coding.comment after each execute step
Honors the 30-minute timeout as a stop condition

Cites missing /loop prefix or invalid invocation form as the reason

evals.prompt:
/loop /coding.loop .ai-agent/plan/login-home.md
完了条件: Analyzer Success
（想定: /coding.design が DO NOT 以外の指摘を一部保留して返した）
evals.expected_output: 保留をユーザー待ちにせず、loop 側で各指摘を全部/一部承認（計画反映）または否認（否認内容・理由をレビュー否認ログへ）し、再レビューする。DO NOT 残0かつ保留・未処理0になるまで execute に進まない。
assertions: Does not treat design 保留 as user-approval wait or leave it unresolved before execute
For deferred non-DO-NOT findings, chooses approve (reflect) and/or deny with an explicit reason
Mentions recording denials in a レビュー否認ログ (or equivalent denial log) on the split plan
Requires re-review after disposition before allowing execute
Blocks execute while any 保留 or undisposed findings remain, even if DO NOT count is already 0
